Clicking on the button "Lost" then adding the reason in the “Lost Reason” field, then click “Create”.

That activity will be, by default, assigned to this user. However, you can assign it to someone else at any time.

In the Settings of the Email app

I can use Odoo Spreadsheet to create a customized report.

What could be easily added in an invoice to structure it further?

The fiscal position applied is the one of the invoicing address.
The fiscal position applied is the one of the delivery address.
Is it possible to modify the amount of an invoice when creating it from a confirmed sale order?

Put the Price of this Sale Order Line at 0

div.p: I founded CityBike one year ago. Today, we have a team of 10 employees, including 3 salespeople, 4 production staff, and 1 accountant. Our company is based in Belgium, and one of our employees speaks only Spanish.

We specialize in reselling customized electric bikes, offering five different mod​els . Each bike features a unique design while sharing common materials. In addition to bikes, we sell a range of accessories, including front baskets, bicycle helmets, phone holders, gloves, headlights, rear lights, and more.
Currently, we use QuickBooks and Google Suite (spreadsheets) to manage our business operations.

div.p:
We have a sales team
that reaches out to potential customers. Prospects can contact us by phone, email , or through the contact form on our website . Once in touch with a prospect, our sales team qualifies them, sends quot​es , and negotiates pricing.
Additionally, we have an intern responsible for cold calling local companies. This intern should only have access to the list of prospects they upload into the CRM and no other information.

div.p:
Our pricing strategy
is complex and depends on several factors: ​​ ​ customer type, product selection, and time of year.
Prices increase by 10% in July and December.

I want our quotations to be clear and visually appealing. I usually attach a technical sheet of each bike to the quote email. It takes so much time, ​can we automate that? It’s also important to separate in the quote the two types of products we offer: Bikes and Accessories.

process by sending:

div.p: Aditionnaly, we sell products in Belgium as well as to foreign companies, which are exempt from taxes.

record.field: Which of the following project management methods does the Odoo Project application use?
How can you add stages to your board view system and change their order?
You can click on the "Add a Column" button and drag and drop the column wherever you want on the board.
You can click on the "Add a Column" button but you can't change the order once the stages are set.
You can't do either of these things.
Where can you change the name of your project ?
You can’t change the name of your project once it’s created.
In the edit form of your project.
Both in the Kanban view and the edit form of your project.
Which of these elements doesn’t appear on the project Kanban view of your project?
What are the allocated hours of a project?
The number of hours you’d need to spend to bring your project to completion.
The number of hours already spent on the project.
The number of hours remaining before the next planned activity.
The number of hours remaining before your project changes color in the Kanban view.
When I configure my project stage(s) (all projects level), which one(s) is/are set as Folded in Kanban by default?
No stage is set as Folded in Kanban by default.
Both the Done and Canceled stages.
When I click on the gear icon next to the stage name, which options do I get for my project stage?
Fold, Edit, Automations, Delete, Archive All, Unarchive All.
Move Stage, Edit Stage, Make a joke, Laugh about it
How can I view only the tasks that are in the state “Approved” at a specific stage?
By clicking on the green part of the gauge under the stage name.
By clicking on the gear icon next to the stage name and selecting “Ready".
By clicking on the green bullet of a task to view them all.
When I create a task from the Kanban view of my project, what are the first things Odoo asks me to specify?
How can I get a list of all the sub-tasks linked to a parent task?
By clicking on the Sub-tasks smart button on the parent task form.
By clicking on “View List” in the Dropdown menu of the Kanban board.
Validating a quotation in the Sales application can create one project task per line item.
The product type has to be a goods in order to appear in Project when sold.
On order, you can choose to create a task, a project and a task, or just a project.
All the tasks of that project move to that stage
All the unfinished tasks of that project move to that stage
All the new tasks of that project move to that stage
The project stage changes, but nothing else happens.
The visibility options allow you to manage the people to whom this project and its tasks will be visible.
Only for anyone with the right URL.
When you add followers to a project…
They are added as followers to all the tasks that already exist within the project
They will be added as followers to all the new tasks you will create within the project
You increase your chances of becoming an influencer on Odoo
When rounding up 30 minutes, with a minimal record of 35 minutes, what is the effective recorded time for a 25 minutes using the timer?
You enabled the “Validated timesheets only” setting in the invoicing policy (Main settings/timesheet). Now, to be able to invoice my customers:
The timesheet entries have to be approved by the responsible person.
The timesheet entries have to be submitted for approval.
The timesheet entries have to be approved by the responsible person on their respective sale order lines.

A fictitious task A: 5 hours were recorded and validated on 12/05 + 3 hours on 12/13 + 4 hours on 12/15. An invoice for the timesheet period 12/04 - 12/14 was issued. How can I see, from the SO, the hours remaining to be invoiced?
Subtracting the Quantity from the Delivered hours.
Subtracting the Invoiced hours from the Delivered hours.
Subtracting the Invoiced hours from the Quantity.
What does the progress bar on the kanban view show?
The status of the activities on the task: late activities, today's activities, future activities.
Status of tasks: In progress, Changes requested and approved.
What does the Non-Billable Tasks category include?
Tasks with time encoded but no sales order linked to it.
Tasks with time encoded but no analytical account set.
Tasks with time encoded that haven’t been invoiced.

div.p: When our customers purchase a bike we offer an optional maintenance service for an annual fee of €150.

This service operates as a package deal: customers can bring their bikes to our shop for regular maintenance up to four times per year. Each time, our technicians take care of all the necessary servicing their bikes need.

To streamline this process, I need the system to automatically generate four tasks
whenever a customer purchases this service. These tasks will allow our technicians to easily:

ul.li: Record details of the maintenance performed (time spent, parts used, and detailed descriptions of what was done)

div.class: row s_col_no_resize s_col_no_bgcolor g-0 o_colored_level o_cc o_cc1 align-items-center

img.class: s_media_list_img h-100 w-100 img img-fluid o_we_custom_image

div.p: In addition to our maintenance service, we also offer a bike repair service, similar to car insurance. If a customer encounters a problem on the road, they can call one of our technicians who will come out and assist the client wherever they are.
To manage this efficiently, I need to have a task created whenever a request is made and assign it to one of my field technicians. These tasks will allow our technicians to easily :

ul.li: Record details of the maintenance performed (time spent, parts used, and detailed descriptions of what was done)

div.p: While this service is available to all our customers, they will be charged based on:

a.font: Any parts replaced during the repair

div.class: row s_col_no_resize s_col_no_bgcolor g-0 o_colored_level o_cc o_cc1 align-items-center

img.class: s_media_list_img h-100 w-100 img img-fluid o_we_custom_image

div.p: Since the service is prepaid, customers will not be required to make any additional payments at the time of maintenance. Invoices are generated and paid just after the sale is completed.
For our bike repair service, customers are billed on a monthly basis. To ensure accurate invoicing I need a system that allows me to:

ul.li: Track the total number of hours each technician spent on repairs throughout the month.
Record the parts and products used after each repair.

div.p: Billing is based on time spent, at a rate of €45 per hour, plus the cost of any replaced parts.
This way, at the end of each month, I can generate an invoice that reflects the actual repair services provided.

record.field: What should I do if I receive my products from the same vendor in two separate deliveries?
Odoo does not take split deliveries into account.
You should create a backorder on the first reception.
You should click on the "no backorder" button after the reception of the first delivery.
Can you confirm a request for quotation after the order deadline has passed?
No, because the request for quotation is automatically canceled.
No, but you can change the deadline and then confirm it.
When can you create a bill for a purchase order with products whose bill control policy is set to ‘On Received Quantities’?
As soon as you create the request for quotation.
Whenever you have confirmed the purchase order.
Whenever you have received all the products.
Whenever you have received some (or all) of the products.
Where will I see the expected arrival date of a purchase for the first time?
My vendor delivery lead time is 10 days. What will be the receipt scheduled date if I order something on the 15th of April?
I have created a reordering rule with a minimum stock of 5 units and a maximum of 10 units. When the reordering rule is triggered, how many units will it order?
As much as needed so you have a minimum of 5 units in stock.
It will always order between 5 and 10 units.
As much as needed so you have 10 units in stock.
Can you create reordering rules on service type products?
Can you create reordering rules on goods products type if you don't check the "track inventory" checkbox?
Only if they are related to a Point of Sale.
Is it possible to link several purchase orders from the same supplier to a single purchase agreement in Odoo?
Yes, using the blanket order/purchase agreement functionality.
No, Odoo does not allow linking POs to agreements
No, each purchase order must have its own separate agreement
Yes, but only one purchase order can be linked at a time.
It is possible to create a backorder...
No, this isn't possible in Odoo.
What is the destination location of products removed from stock through a manual inventory adjustment?
When I sell products tracked in the inventory (storable) to a customer (1-step delivery), products go from ...
A virtual location to a partner location.
An internal location to a virtual location.
An internal location to a customer location.
A customer location to an internal location.
Where can I define removal strategies (FIFO, LIFO, FEFO) ?
On product forms and product categories.
On source locations and product categories.
I purchase milk in the unit of measure "pack of 6 bottles" but sell it by the bottle. I have no other packagings set on my product. In my inventory, the milk will be stored in:
You can chose on the product form UOM field
What happens if I select "Product Categories" in my route's settings?
This route will be applied to all my product categories automatically.
This route will be selectable on my product categories.
It locks the product category settings so they can no longer be edited.
Where can I choose to track a product by its serial number?
In the General Information tab of the product form.
In the Purchase tab of the product form.
In the Sales tab of the product form.
In the internal reference field of the product form.
During which step in the process (purchase to sale) do I have to register my serial numbers so they can be added to the inventory?
How can I ensure that the first product that entered my stock is delivered first on my next sale order?
By selecting FIFO as your Removal Strategy.
By selecting LIFO as your Removal Strategy.
By selecting LIFO as your Put Away Strategy.
By selecting FIFO as your Put Away Strategy.
Which settings need to be enabled to configure a specific removal strategy on locations?
Lots/Serial numbers, multi-steps routes, storage location.
Can a product have multiple bills of materials?
What should you do if you want to use an alternative work center when the primary one is already in use?
Add the second work center as the alternative to the first one. Then, create or edit a routing and add an operation using the secondary work center.
Add the second work center as the alternative to the first one. The alternative work center will be automatically assigned when the first one is in use.
Add the primary work center as the alternative to the other one. Then, create an Assembly Route that goes through the alternative work center.
When creating an operation in a Bill of Materials (BoM), is it mandatory to designate a work center?
Yes, defining a work center is mandatory.
No, work centers can be chosen later.
No, the work center is added after each step in the operation is completed.
What is the ‘capacity’ of a work center?
The number of operations from a BoM the work center can perform simultaneously.
The number of items that can be processed at the work center simultaneously
The number of workers at the work center.
The number of manufacturing orders that simultaneously use the work center.
Your work center has a capacity of 3, and your BoM, which produces 4 products, has an operation time of 10 minutes. What is the expected time spent to produce 4 products?
Where can I find the operation cost of a BoM?
The Hour Cost of the Employee performing the operation.
The Cost of each Material and that’s it.
Where can you specify that your product should be subcontracted?
Can you mark a work order as done without processing all the steps (quality checks) ?
Yes, but only when multiple employees are logged in.
Yes, but only if one of the quality checks is performed.
What does an orange color for a “Component Status” on a manufacturing order indicate?
Component is not in stock, but it will arrive in time for scheduled production.
Odoo is updating the component status.
What is a Bill of Material?
It is the cost of all the materials needed to manufacture a part.
It is the recipe to put something together.
It is a person in charge of manufacturing materials.
How would you configure products in order to manage the procurement of those in Odoo?
What is the difference between a Manufacturing BOM and a Kit BOM?
A Kit BOM can only contain one component, whereas a Manufacturing BOM must contain at least ten.
A Manufacture BOM is used for manufacturing one product and a Kit is used for delivering the components without manufacturing them.
It doesn't. Manufacturing is a standalone app.
What does it mean to Scrap Inventory?
It means scratching it, causing damage.
It means to add inventory to stock.
It means to remove inventory from stock (after receiving it and noticing damages/uselessness).

div.p:
We strive to prod​uce
as much as possible in our own warehouses. However, due to limited production space, we source frames, pedals, and raw materials directly from our main supplier, AllforBike. Maintaining a minimum stock of these components
is crucial, as we need to manufacture semi-finished and finished products as soon as we receive an order.

div.class: row s_col_no_resize s_col_no_bgcolor g-0 o_colored_level o_cc o_cc1 align-items-center

div.p:
Our handlebars and wheels (semi-finished products) are manufactured on demand
from raw materials. The final assembly of our bikes includes the frame, pedals, handlebars, and wheels.

div.class: row s_col_no_resize s_col_no_bgcolor g-0 align-items-center o_colored_level o_cc o_cc1

div.p:
Once a bike is fully assembled, it undergoes a quality control
check to ensure it meets our standards. After passing inspection, we store the finished bikes in our warehouse until they are ready for shipment to customers. Tracking our finished products with serial numbers is essential for inventory management and quality assurance.

Where does the account come from if a product does not have one specified?
Odoo will use the first active income account from the Chart of Accounts
Odoo will use the income account specified on the journal
Odoo will take the income account specified on the product category if there is one
Odoo will not let you add a product without an income account configured on it
Apart from miscellaneous, what are the different types of journals you can create?
Cash, Bank, Sales, Loan, and Purchase
Cash, Bank, Sales, Purchase, and Tax
Bank, Cash, Credit card, Sales, and Purchase
Bank, Cash, Sales, Purchase, and Adjustments
What invoicing options options are available upon sales order validation?
Regular invoice, down payment (percentage), down payment (fixed), up payment (percentage)
Regular invoice, down payment (percentage), down payment (fixed amount)
Regular Invoice, Down payment (percentage), down payment (fixed amount), Batch Invoice
Regular invoice, irregular invoice, down payment (percentage), down payment (fixed)
Where can you find the "invoicing policy" field?
In the "Other Info" tab of the invoice
Both in Settings and on the product form
It's social credit from the customer for a job well done
It's a logged note indicating that the customer owes you money

A dedicated Credit Note Sequence must be activated in the associated Journal
A new Journal for credit notes needs to be created
Nothing needs to be done to issue a credit note
The Credit Note setting must be checked in Settings under configuration
For either a partial or total amount
What is the difference between the bill date and the accounting date?
The bill date is the date of issuance and the accounting date is when it gets accounted for in the books
The bill date is the reporting date and the accounting date is when it gets accounted for in the books
The bill date is when you need to bill for the goods and the accounting date is when you need to send the bill
It fills in the bill lines based on the contents of the attached PDF documents
It fills in the bill lines using AI based on previous purchases from the associated vendor
It fills in the bill lines from the selected purchase orders

A. Within the additional fields in the list view of all purchase orders
B. In the chatter of the Purchase Order
